app.name: shim
library.title: Library
library.empty.title: No games yet
library.empty.body: Run a scan to find games from Steam, Epic, GOG and the other launchers you enabled in Settings.
library.empty.noScan: Scanning needs Windows. This build is running on {platform}, so the library stays empty here.
library.unavailable: No scanner for {launchers} in this build yet.
game.notFound: This game is no longer in the library.
game.pendingBody: Run a scan to read this game's executable, DLSS files and anti-cheat markers.
game.route.title: What shim would do
game.route.antiCheat: {name} protects this game. Injecting into it can get the account banned, so shim does nothing here.
game.route.unsupported: shim cannot help with this game yet: {reason}.
game.changes.title: What will change
game.changes.body: Every file below is recorded. Anything overwritten is backed up first and restored on uninstall.
game.changes.none: Nothing: this game has no route.
game.installDone: Done. {n} file(s) written; everything is recorded and can be undone.
game.removeDone: Removed. Every backup was restored and every added file deleted.
game.installFailed: Install failed and was rolled back. Nothing changed.
game.removeConfirm.title: Remove shim from this game?
game.removeConfirm.body: {n} file(s) will be restored or deleted exactly as recorded at install time. The game itself is not touched.
game.antiCheat.title: {name} anti-cheat detected
game.antiCheat.body: Injecting into a game with kernel anti-cheat can get the account banned. shim will not stop you, but you take the risk. Type REMOVE-MY-DOUBTS to continue.
game.exactPlan: Exact file list, from the components and files you have in place.
game.sketchPlan: Rough file list. The exact one appears once components and your files are ready.
game.advanced.title: Advanced
game.advanced.body: How the DLSS 5 pass gets into this game. Only for games that ship DLSS; change it before installing.
game.advanced.locked: Remove the current install to change this.
game.mode.dlss5Hint: ReShade hosts the RenoDX DLSS 5 add-on over the game's own DLSS. Default; what the known-working setups use.
game.mode.optiscaler_dlss5Hint: wilsjo2's OptiScaler fork with the DLSS 5 model built in, run before the upscaler at render resolution (cheaper than on the full output). One DLL, no ReShade. RTX 20 to 50.
game.mode.optiscaler_onlyHint: Upstream OptiScaler: swaps DLSS for another upscaler. No DLSS 5 pass; your model is not used.
game.elevateHint: The game folder is not writable from here. shim can restart with administrator rights for this one install.
settings.folders.title: Custom folders
settings.folders.body: Each subfolder with a game executable is treated as a game.
settings.hidden.title: Hidden games
settings.hidden.body: Hidden games stay in the library but are not shown. Right-click a card to hide it.
components.title: Components
components.body: Everything shim installs comes from the publisher's own release page, pinned by version and SHA-256. Nothing is bundled.
components.model.title: Your files
components.model.body: Files shim never downloads. Pick each one; its size, SHA-256 and signature are shown so you know what you have.
components.user.modelHint: Needed by every route. Comes from NVIDIA; shim only records its hash and signature.
components.user.renodxHint: Needed by every route: it is the add-on that runs the DLSS 5 model. Published on the RenoDX Discord, not on a release page, so shim cannot fetch it.
components.user.runtimeHint: Needed for games without DLSS. An NVIDIA runtime; copy it from a game that ships DLSS.
components.signature.hash_mismatch: Signature by {signer} does not match the file
components.updated: Pins reviewed {date}. Every download is checked against its SHA-256 before anything is unpacked.
settings.title: Settings
settings.scan.title: Scan sources
settings.scan.body: Which launchers to look at. Custom folders arrive in Phase 3.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.body: Only opens the release page in your browser. Nothing is downloaded or run.
settings.about.title: About
support.label: Support shim
support.hint: shim is free and bundles nothing. If it saved you an evening, a coffee keeps it going.
support.afterInstall: Worked for you? shim is free; a coffee helps.
